prompt:
You are the communication step of RiceBridge Ops, an irrigation agent for a 6-field rice cluster that shares one pump station in An Giang.

Deterministic tools have ALREADY computed the plan (water balance, crop-stage safety, pump capacity). You must not change any action, order, date or number. Your job:
1. headline_en / headline_vi: one sentence each that tells the pump-station manager what the plan does and the single most important reason, combining the events in INPUT.recent_events.
2. explain_en: 2-3 plain-English sentences for a non-expert audience on why the order is what it is (use the reasons given).
3. messages: one chat message per field in INPUT.rows (same fid), short (max 2 sentences), polite southern Vietnamese (anh/chị, nhé), plus English. Say clearly whether to open the inlet (and when HTX calls) or keep it closed and wait. For F3 (Bà Sáu, no smartphone) write the message to the HTX officer asking him to tell bà Sáu. If a row has measure_first true, ask HTX to measure that field before opening the inlet.

Hard constraint: every number you write must appear in INPUT (levels, dates, field numbers, mm). Do not invent yields, money, emissions or percentages.

Reply with ONE JSON object only, no prose, no code fence. It must match this JSON schema:
{"type": "object", "required": ["headline_en", "headline_vi", "explain_en", "messages"], "properties": {"headline_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "headline_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 240}, "explain_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 600}, "messages": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "required": ["fid", "text_vi", "text_en"], "properties": {"fid": {"type": "string", "enum": ["F1", "F2", "F3", "F4", "F5", "F6"]}, "text_vi": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 260}, "text_en": {"type": "string", "maxLength": 300}}}}}}

data.headline_en: Pump run Fri 06 Mar opens F6 first, then F4, because both would reach flowering or top-dressing without standing water; the other four fields wait for Tue 10 Mar.
data.headline_vi: Lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar mở cống F6 trước, rồi F4, vì hai thửa này sẽ thiếu nước đứng đúng lúc bón thúc và trổ; các thửa còn lại chờ đợt Tue 10 Mar.
data.explain_en: F6 goes first because its top-dressing window starts on Fri 06 Mar and the water is projected to be at −4.9 cm. F4 comes second because it starts flowering on Sat 07 Mar and its fast-draining soil (4.4 mm/day) has already lost its standing water, but its last reading is 6 days old, so HTX should measure it before opening the inlet. F1, F2, F3 and F5 were re-flooded and can wait for the next run on Tue 10 Mar.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 6 ơi, mực nước dự kiến xuống −4.9 cm đúng lúc bón thúc, nên mở cống thửa 6 trước ở lượt bơm Fri 06 Mar nhé. HTX sẽ báo khi tới lượt.
messages.text_en: Field 6: open the inlet first in the Fri 06 Mar pump run, because the water is projected at −4.9 cm when top-dressing starts. HTX will call when it is your turn.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 4 ơi, nhờ HTX đo lại nước thửa 4 trước khi mở cống nhé, vì số đo cuối đã 6 ngày. Sau đó mở cống ở lượt thứ 2 của Fri 06 Mar, HTX sẽ báo.
messages.text_en: Field 4: HTX please measure this field before opening the inlet, since the last reading is 6 days old. Then open it second in the Fri 06 Mar run; HTX will call.

messages.text_vi: Anh/chị thửa 1 ơi, thửa mình vừa có nước lại, chưa cần mở cống, giữ cống đóng và chờ đợt bơm Tue 10 Mar nhé.
